description: Verify that DUT discards a UDP datagram whose Source IP Address is the directed broadcast (RFC 1122 §4.1.3.6 + §3.2.1.3 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Companion of INVALID_ADDRESSES_01 for the broadcast-source variant: a directed-broadcast src_ip is also illegal — no single host owns that address. DUT must drop the datagram.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: UDP datagram
   • src_ip = directed broadcast (e.g. 172.16.255.255)   ← key trigger
   • dst_ip = DUT IP

2. Observation:
   • DUT's upper-tester must NOT receive the datagram (UT-query confirms drop)

[Pass condition]
UT-query confirms DUT did not deliver the broadcast-source UDP.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_receipt — DUT delivered the broadcast-source UDP
• Fail_timeout — UT-query never arrived (test infra issue)

verdicts.Pass: DUT discarded UDP with broadcast src_ip — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_receipt: DUT received UDP with broadcast src_ip
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No UT confirmation for broadcast-src discard
